# CWP: scripted effects from the base game's scripted_effects, needed by the restored vanilla flavour events
# (the mod blanks the vanilla files of this folder). Generated by docs/maintenance/restore_flavour_events.py.

# from 00_scripted_effects.txt
civil_war_save_scopes = {
	save_scope_as = ongoing_revolution
	political_movement = {
		save_scope_as = ongoing_revolution_movement
	}
}

# from 00_victoria_ep2_scripted_effects.txt
revoke_temporary_event_immortality = { # Otherwise revoked in on_monthly_pulse_character
	hidden_effect = {
		$CHARACTER$ ?= {
			if = {
				limit = {
					is_immortal = yes
					has_variable = temporary_immortality_var
					NOT = { has_variable = immortal_at_start_of_event_var }
				}
				set_character_immortal = no # sets character back to not immortal
				remove_variable = temporary_immortality_var
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = immortal_at_start_of_event_var
				}
				remove_variable = immortal_at_start_of_event_var
			}
		}
	}
}

set_temporary_event_immortality = {
	hidden_effect = {
		if = { # this is to ensure a character won't die during the event but an already immortal character doesn't lose immortality at the end of the event
			limit = {
				is_immortal = no # checks if the character isn't already immortal
			}
			set_character_immortal = yes
			set_variable = { name = temporary_immortality_var value = $DURATION$ }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = immortal_at_start_of_event_var months = $DURATION$ }
		}
	}
}
